list: The official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation (names, descriptions and grades via Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18). Guides are this site's own words, written from the official descriptions.
roadmap: Stage 1 — Story first: the chapter and named-mission trophies, in order.
Stage 2 — Missables, while the story is still open: the 8 flagged trophies.
Stage 3 — Side strands and the open world: character strands, strangers, meditation, hunting, gangs.
Stage 4 — Activities and collections: the long counts — stunts, races, shooting range, cards, vehicles, areas.
Stage 5 — Money, then the platinum: laundering, spending, garages, 100% completion.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is no separate task — the roadmap in this guide is the plan. Play the story first, then the side strands, then the long grinds (stunts, the shooting range, collectibles) last, and read the missables page early so nothing needs a second playthrough.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed — just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission-complete screen. Nothing here needs preparation, and nothing can go wrong; it is the game's way of saying welcome to Leonida.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full. Story chapters unlock in order, so keep playing the main missions; the trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen. No side content is needed for it, and no chapter trophy can be missed — the story always moves forward.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same rule as every chapter trophy: main missions only, in order, and it pops when the chapter closes. If you are chasing the platinum efficiently, push the story forward and leave the open-world grinding until free roam.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep working through the main missions in order; the trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen. Chapter trophies are the backbone of the roadmap — each one marks a new stretch of the map and new side content opening up.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Main missions only, in order, and it pops when the chapter closes. By this point in the story most of Leonida is open, so it is a good moment to sweep up side strands and activities before the finale.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. It pops at the end of the last mission, and after the credits free roam opens, so anything not yet earned can still be chased. Do the trophies flagged missable in this guide before the finale if you want to be safe — everything else waits patiently.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is unmissable — play it when it appears in the mission list and finish it. Named story missions like this one are the milestones between the chapter trophies.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are the set-pieces of the story: follow the plan the game lays out, and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. No preparation outside the mission is needed.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable story mission — play it when it appears and finish it. These named mission trophies are why the story is the first stage of the roadmap.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play it when it appears in the mission list and finish it; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. Nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It takes place around Vice City International Airport — fitting, since the airport is also home to the Catch Me If You Can trophy. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable story mission — play it when it appears and finish it. The name suggests a big set-piece; bring plenty of ammo and follow the objectives.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game stats page shows what counts: story, side strands, activities, collectibles and the rest. This is the long grind and the last gold most players earn; use the checklist here to tick off each category as it fills, and expect the shooting range, the stunts and the collectibles to be the tail of the run.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses, airtime and similar driving feats, and the game counts them as you drive. Chain them on long highway runs and around Vice City's jumps — the count builds across the whole playthrough, so start early and it will be close to done by the finale. PSN tracks the count toward 250.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 250. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types in Leonida — fishing, races, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, drone races, meditation, hunting, and one more the game lists under Activities. Open the Activities menu, try one of each, and the trophy pops on the ninth type. A cheap early trophy: sample everything as you find it, and the rest of the activity trophies will follow naturally.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit a shooting range and work through the challenges weapon by weapon; gold needs speed and accuracy, so learn each challenge's layout with a practice run first, then go for the gold time and score. This is one of the longest grinds in the list — save it for after the story, when you can focus. PSN tracks 42 challenges.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 42. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone-race spots around Leonida; win one race at each. Learn each course's racing line, cut corners where the gates allow, and remember that a win at a location is what counts — repeat visits to the same spot do not stack. PSN tracks 14 locations.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 14. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct race events count — street races, off-road, boat or air races the game offers. Repeat wins of the same race do not count twice, so keep moving to new events on the map. PSN tracks the count toward 20.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 20. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his challenge; fishing here is about timing the reel and keeping the tension in the safe zone. Win the head-to-head and the trophy pops. If you lose, challenge him again — fishing challenges can be retried.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Step up to any arcade cabinet in Leonida and finish a full game — reaching the credits or a game-over screen both count as completing it, so pick a short one and see it through. Arcades are also where you will sample one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a chain of side missions; each one unlocks the next, so keep answering his calls and the last mission pops this trophy. Side strands stay available in free roam, so there is no rush — but do them before the finale if you like a tidy map.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's side-mission chain in order; the final mission in the strand pops the trophy. Like the other character strands, it stays open in free roam after the story.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is a chain of side missions; finish each one as it unlocks and the last one pops the trophy. A good strand to clear between story chapters, when you want a break from the main missions.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Strangers appear as question-markers on the map; each strand is a short chain of missions. Finish any 8 full strands — there are more than 8 in the state, so pick the ones nearest you and skip any that feel like a chore. PSN tracks the count toward 8.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 8. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a chain of side missions; finish each as it unlocks and the last one pops the trophy. Side strands stay available in free roam, so fold them into the clean-up stage of the roadmap.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work through Tyrone's side-mission chain in order; the final mission pops the trophy. All five character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) work the same way: a chain, a finale, a trophy.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots — quiet viewpoints, beaches and hilltops the game marks once found. Sit, meditate, and the spot counts. Sweep the map region by region; the last few are usually the remote ones, far from the cities. PSN tracks 18 spots.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 18. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand points you at a rare animal; track it, take the shot cleanly, and bring the result back to Bret. A scoped rifle and patience beat rushing — spook it and you will be tracking it again.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; each set needs every card in it. Collect any 3 full sets — the checklist's collectibles filter helps track which sets are closest to done, and it is worth finishing the set you have already started before chasing a new one. PSN tracks the count toward 3.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 3. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo and check-in feature; use it at 100 distinct locations across the map. It stacks across the whole game, so check in whenever you arrive somewhere new — by the end of a thorough playthrough the count is most of the way there. PSN tracks the count toward 100.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 100. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — driving, combat, exploration and more — listed under the Challenges menu. Finish any 50; the easy early ones (short drives, first-time feats) are the fastest route to the count, and the rest fill in naturally as you play. PSN tracks the count toward 50.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 50. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear — alleys, tunnels and water all help. Flagged missable: partner missions are the easiest time to have your partner beside you, so do this one early, while the story still puts you together often.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Three robberies in a row, partner at your side, wanted level never dropping in between — plan a route of three close shops, keep the getaway car ready, and do not let the cops catch you between stops. Flagged missable for the same reason as Hot Together: do it while partner missions are plentiful.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive counts once — cars, bikes, boats and aircraft. Drive anything you have not driven before; the vehicle list in the pause menu shows what you have found. A natural trophy for a player who samples every car park and marina. PSN tracks the count toward 100.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 100. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies close together — a gang hideout or a wanted-level shootout — and drop five before the focus ends. Shotguns and SMGs help at close range; pick a fight where the enemies come to you.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, leave by an aircraft or route that is not a scheduled flight — steal a plane and take off. Flagged missable: do it while the airport is open to you, before the late story changes access to the airfield.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the military tanks; get into trouble near one, survive the encounter, or take one on — the trophy pops from the tank encounter itself. Expect a big wanted level, and do not try it on foot in the open.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: a stealth approach, avoiding cameras and guards' sightlines, take the goods and leave before the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — a failed attempt does not lock you out. Flagged missable: do it before the finale, while the store's setup is unchanged.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate bank-vault robberies, each ending in a clean escape. Plan the exit before the entry, keep a fast car outside, and treat each vault as its own job — the count is per completed escape, not per attempt. PSN tracks the count toward 5.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 5. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck on the road, break it open, grab the cash and lose the wanted level. Trucks run regular routes — follow one until the road is quiet, then strike where there is room to run.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit all 52 named areas of the state — the map shades each one in as you arrive. The last few are the small islands and the far corners of the map, so sweep the edges when the count stalls. PSN tracks the count toward 52.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 52. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs in Leonida; rob one illegal operation from each. The operations show on the map once you have found them — one per gang is all it takes, so spread your attention across the whole state. PSN tracks the count toward 9.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 9. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Sit at a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. It is a quiet moment trophy — no combat, no timer. Flagged as one to do early, while the beach bars are easy to reach and the story has not pulled you elsewhere.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's frontage — pick a showroom, build speed outside, and crash straight out through the glass. Classic GTA chaos, and the trophy pops on the exit.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish it — the follow-through line is about completing the game, not the score. Flagged missable: alley access can change late in the story, so play your game while you are in the area.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A story-adjacent moment with your partner that draws a crowd — it pops from a specific partner scene, so keep playing the partner missions and it will come. There is nothing to grind here; it is a moment to enjoy when it arrives.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count toward 500 for this one — choices across the game add up: dialogue picks, mission decisions and side choices. Play naturally and the count climbs; if it is still short after the story, a second playthrough's different choices finish it off.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 500. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the retry — the trophy is about the comeback. If a mission or challenge beats you once, the second attempt's success pops it. Flagged as one to catch early, while you are still failing things for the first time.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange in Leonida — the game's odd encounters and easter eggs. Roam the weird corners of the map (the desert, the swamps, the night sky) and one of them will find you. This one rewards curiosity more than any plan.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar, not a gun. Slow the car, swing, and connect. Flagged as one to try early, while traffic is dense in the city and you are driving through crowds.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies; launder them through your contacts a little at a time until $250,000 is clean. It stacks across the whole game, and the big story heists move the counter fastest. PSN tracks the count toward $250,000.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of $250,000. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, food, car mods — all shop spending counts toward the $100,000 total. Buy the gear you want anyway and the counter fills itself; if it is short at the end, car mods are the fastest way to spend big. PSN tracks the count toward $100,000.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of $100,000. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garage properties for sale around Leonida; buy them all. They double as storage for your vehicle collection, so they are worth owning early — and they feed straight into the Whip It Good vehicle count. PSN tracks the count toward 8.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 8. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone and register any 10 vehicles you have driven — the app lists them — and the trophy pops on the tenth. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good: every new vehicle you discover can be registered here too. PSN tracks the count toward 10.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN progress target of 10. Guide: our own words, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game.
